events.name: Utah Mammoth at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Andrei Vasilevskiy made 28 saves for his second shutout of the season and 42nd of his career, Darren Raddysh scored on a power play late in the second period, and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Utah Mammoth 2-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Andrei Vasilevskiy makes 28 saves in 2nd shutout of season as Lightning blank Mammoth 2-0

events.name: Boston Bruins at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Matthew Robertson scored at 3:53 of overtime as the New York Rangers beat the Boston Bruins 4-3 on Monday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Robertson scores in OT to lift the Rangers over the Bruins 4-3

events.name: New York Islanders at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Ilya Sorokin stopped 21 shots for his NHL-best sixth shutout of the season and Jean-Gabriel Pageau scored two goals to lead the New York Islanders to a 4-0 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sorokin's 6th shutout and Pageau's 2 goals power Islanders to 4-0 win over Flyers

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Mattias Ekholm scored a hat trick and the Edmonton Oilers rode a dominant second period to a 7-4 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ekholm scores hat trick as Oilers hold off Ducks for 7-4 victory
